brandStory.description: Every candle is poured by hand in small batches, made to turn an ordinary evening into something worth keeping.

craft.label: Our craft
craft.title: Thirty years of light and scent
craft.p1: Every Solenne candle begins with natural soy wax from sustainably farmed sources, a cotton wick, and fragrance composed in Grasse. We choose each material for how it burns and how it carries scent.
craft.p2: Our chandlers pour each batch by hand in small quantities. Three decades of practice sit behind the details: slow pours, steady temperatures, and two weeks of curing before a candle leaves the studio.
craft.p3: Each vessel is finished with a hand-embossed label and made to be kept, then reused. Light it, and an ordinary room becomes somewhere you want to stay.

about.heroTitle: Thirty years of light and scent
about.heroDescription: Solenne began with a simple idea: a candle is more than fragrance. It is a small ritual at the end of the day, made from materials we are glad to bring into a home.
about.craftP1: Every candle is poured in our studio in small batches. We work at a pace that lets us check each one, because the details are the point.
about.craftP2: From wick placement to the final trim, each step follows the same routine: controlled pouring temperatures, cotton wicks, and fourteen days of curing before a candle is ready.
about.ingredientsP1: Natural soy wax grown in the United States, lead-free cotton wicks, and fragrance oils composed in Grasse. No phthalates, no petroleum byproducts.
about.ingredientsP2: Each scent opens in three stages: top notes that greet you, a heart that carries through the evening, and a base that stays in the room after the flame is out.
about.sustainabilityP1: Our glass vessels are heavy enough to reuse once the candle is finished. Jars, cartons and ribbons are sustainably sourced and recyclable.
about.sustainabilityP2: We offset shipping emissions and keep packaging minimal and plastic-free.
